title: Introduce region-locked service aliases, RBACv2 adapter, and KMS provenance tracer
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: customers require stronger guarantees that service endpoints and operator actions cannot be used to cross regional boundaries for regulated tenants. This PR adds three coordinated pieces: (1) a region-locked service alias layer that lets operators declare service aliases bound to a specific residency zone and rejects cross-zone resolution at the gateway; (2) an RBACv2 policy adapter and migration shim to convert legacy role bindings to attribute-driven, region-aware constraints; (3) a KMS provenance tracer that records per-request KMS key metadata, signs audit payloads with a provenance envelope, and exposes a compact proof for compliance ingestion. The change is designed to be opt-in initially via a FeatureFlagRegionLocking gate and rolled out to Dedicated and Private deployments first. Checklist: - Feature flag gated in config and console UI toggles added; - Migration tool (cli/rbacv2-migrate) with dry-run and apply modes; - E2E tests for cross-region request rejection and audit proof shape; - Backward compatibility: legacy bindings are still honored until admin-run migration completes; - Rollback plan: disable feature flag and revert adapter deployment; - Monitoring: added metrics rbac.adapter.migrations, kms.provenance.failures, gateway.regionlock.rejections. Migration notes: run `./bin/rbac-migrate --linear ENG-9821 --dry-run` to preview policy transformations; when ready, run with --apply, then enable feature flag for tenants incrementally. Audit path: the provenance tracer attaches signed metadata (kms_key_id, kms_provider_region, envelope_sig) to audit entries and writes a compact index entry to /audit/proofs for downstream retention pipelines. Compatibility: the tracer supports existing CMKs and AWS/GCP provider plugins; new providers can implement the ProvenanceDriver interface. Security review summary: threat modelling concluded that signed provenance reduces ambiguity in audit stores by preventing KMS-origin spoofing; however, care taken to limit sensitive payloads in traces. Document links: RFC attached in PR; migration playbook added to docs/security/region-locked-services.md. Merge: squashed and merged after approvals and green CI.

release_notes: Adds region-locked service aliases to enforce residency at gateway level; introduces RBACv2 migration adapter with dry-run/apply CLI; introduces KMS provenance tracer that signs audit proofs for downstream compliance ingestion. Feature is behind a feature flag and off by default. Admins should run rbac-migrate in dry-run before enabling.
